novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a mechanistic per-token measurement of the hypothesis that “a small set of ‘load-bearing’ tokens ... carries most computation, while connective and hedging tokens are near-inert.” Searches for “per-token causal importance chain-of-thought,” “reasoning token pruning attention attribution,” and “necessary redundant CoT steps” identify TokenSkip (2025), Causal Sufficiency and Necessity Improves Chain-of-Thought Reasoning (2025), and Thought Anchors: Which LLM Reasoning Steps Matter? as close prior work already proposing unequal token/step importance, causal identification of indispensable reasoning content, and pruning of redundant content. Moving to a three-signal combination of attention attribution, residual-stream probes, and token-level KV ablation is a natural extension using standard interpretability tools rather than a new core relationship, although the finer-grained mechanistic triangulation modestly distinguishes the instance.
